verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a search API, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows Brave Search API only as a hosted service reached with an API key against api.search.brave.com, backed by Brave's own crawled index. The open-source MCP server only wraps the hosted API, and the Open WebUI and Dify guides describe self-hosted third-party tools that call it, so none of these make the core search index or service self-hostable.
